scripts.//env: Unlike Next.js, a plain Node process does not read .env.local. --env-file-if-exists keeps this working on Railway, where the file is absent and variables come from the platform.
scripts.//loader: Use the tsx binary rather than `node --import tsx/esm`. The latter loads this CommonJS-configured package through the ESM pipeline, and the shared db export resolves to undefined at module scope in some files but not others — a genuinely confusing failure.
